skill.name: review-animations
skill.description: Reviews interface animation and motion code for purpose, responsiveness, physicality, performance, interruptibility, accessibility, and product cohesion.
skill.summary: Apply a focused craft review to interface animations and receive specific, standards-based findings.
skill.author: emilkowalski

content.value_statement: Interface motion can feel slow, distracting, or inaccessible even when it works. This skill reviews animation code against specific craft, performance, and accessibility standards.
actual_capabilities: Reviews animation purpose, frequency, duration, easing, and product cohesion.
Flags layout-property animation, transform shortcuts, and other performance risks.
Checks interruptibility for rapid interactions, gestures, toasts, and toggles.
Evaluates reduced-motion support and hover behavior for accessibility.
Produces a findings table with specific replacements, reasons, and a final verdict.
Uses documented duration ranges, easing curves, spring guidance, and gesture standards.
limitations: Reviews motion-related code only and does not provide a general code review.
Cannot directly judge perceived smoothness without runtime footage or an interactive build.
Recommendations reflect the included motion philosophy and may require product context.
Does not implement fixes unless another tool or workflow applies the recommendations.

use_cases.title: Review a component change
use_cases.description: Check a pull request for easing, duration, physical origin, performance, and accessibility issues before merge.

use_cases.title: Audit a motion system
use_cases.description: Compare shared transitions and interaction patterns against consistent motion standards across a product.

use_cases.title: Validate interaction quality
use_cases.description: Identify distracting, sluggish, or unnecessary motion and receive clear recommendations for refinement.

prompt_templates.title: Review one animation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the animation in [file or snippet]. Check its purpose, duration, easing, animated properties, and reduced-motion support. Return the required findings and verdict.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single transition

prompt_templates.title: Review a component interaction
prompt_templates.prompt: Review motion in [component]. Consider trigger frequency, transform origin, entry and exit timing, hover gating, and interruptibility. Cite each affected file and line.

prompt_templates.title: Audit gesture performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the drag or gesture animation in [files]. Evaluate pointer handling, velocity, damping, interruption, main-thread work, and GPU-friendly properties. Recommend precise changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review a complete motion diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Review all motion changes in this diff. Apply the full standards catalog, rank findings by impact, propose exact replacements, and issue an approval or block decision.

output_examples.input: Review a dropdown that scales from the center over 400 milliseconds and lacks reduced-motion handling.
output_examples.output: The review blocks the change, recommends a trigger-aware origin and shorter responsive timing, and adds a reduced-motion variant.

output_examples.input: Review a toast entrance implemented with keyframes and layout-property animation.
output: Replace restarting keyframes with an interruptible transition or spring.
Move the animation to transform and opacity.
Verify rapid additions and dismissals without dropped frames.

output_examples.input: Review a subtle button press that uses a short transform transition and supports reduced motion.
output_examples.output: The review approves the motion when its frequency, scale, and timing remain appropriate for the interaction.

best_practices: Provide the changed files, line context, and interaction frequency.
Include product intent and any runtime constraints that affect motion decisions.
Test recommendations on real devices and with reduced-motion settings enabled.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for unrelated architecture, security, or business-logic review.
Do not request approval without supplying the animation code or diff.
Do not treat numeric guidance as a substitute for runtime observation and product context.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews interface animation and motion code for craft, performance, interruptibility, accessibility, and cohesion.

faq.question: Does it write animation code?
faq.answer: It focuses on review findings and recommended replacements. It does not implement features or unrelated fixes.

faq.question: Which animation technologies can it assess?
faq.answer: It can assess CSS transitions, keyframes, Web Animations API usage, spring-based motion, and common Framer Motion patterns.

faq.question: How does it handle reduced motion?
faq.answer: It checks for gentler alternatives that preserve useful feedback while removing unnecessary movement.

faq.question: Can it approve a pull request?
faq.answer: It provides an explicit approve or block recommendation based on the supplied motion changes.

faq.question: What context improves the review?
faq.answer: Provide the diff, affected interactions, usage frequency, product style, performance constraints, and available runtime evidence.
